name: PSLab
blurb: An all-in-one open-source laboratory for scientific experiments and electronic measurements.
description:
An all-in-one open-source laboratory for scientific experiments and electronic measurements.

The Pocket Science Lab (PSLab) app pairs with open-source PSLab hardware to give you an array of essential measuring instruments in a single interface. Designed for makers, educators, and engineers.

Available instruments:

• Oscilloscope

• Multimeter

• Logic Analyzer

• Waveform Generator

• Power Source

• Luxmeter

• Barometer

• Accelerometer

• Gyrometer

• Compass

• Thermometer

• Gas Sensor

• Dust Sensor

• Robotic Arm Controller
